messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Review and Decision-Making" as it appears in the following examples.
['Endeavor to contact me immediately through my e-mail address above, to indicate whether you are interested in this deal.', 'When it comes to Magic do you really think overlooking literally **anything** would be a wise decision?', 'I seek your consent to present you as the next of kin to the deceased so that the $15million dollars can be remitted to your account, and then we can share the money,25% to you and 70% for us, while 5% will take care of all expenses that might be incurred on the cause of the transfer.', 'If you can be a collaborator/partner to this please indicate interest immediately for us to proceed.', 'Do confirm if you have given Mr.James Taylor the right to claim your fund,and if you are incapacitated.', 'I decided to propose to you this business in strict confidence.', 'Because the order was made from a European internet address, we put an Exception Payment on transaction ID #PayPal-m37321 motivated by our Tracking System.', 'A new transaction requires your authorization.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
